name: tessri
description: Keep code understandable while the agent works: what a change can reach, who can review it and what nobody maintains, with the evidence for every claim. The questions as tools, a skill for when to ask them, and hooks that answer after each edit and when the agent stops. Zero dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: What a change can reach, who can review it and what nobody maintains, with the evidence.
interface.longDescription: Tessri reads the repository and its git history and answers a maintainer's questions with the evidence for every claim: what depends on a file and which tests reach it, which changed files deserve a person first and who can look, what the uncommitted work did to the structure, and what nobody maintains. The plugin brings the questions as tools, a skill that says when to ask them, and hooks that answer after each edit and when the agent stops. It carries its own copy of Tessri and needs nothing installed.
defaultPrompt: What can a change to this file reach?
Which files of my change deserve a reviewer first, and who can look?
What did my uncommitted work do to the structure?
